attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory permissions on node1: created inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group, set recursive ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, set dirs to 750 and files to 640 (no access for others). Verified read access works for owner and group members but is denied for unrelated users, and file contents (records.csv, config.json) were preserved unchanged. Completed mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id/uptime/permissions/checksums, triggered a systemd reboot on node1, polled until reconnection, confirmed boot_id changed, and reverified permissions, ownership, and file checksums matched the pre-restart baseline.
